crossRefs.note: “Look, Yahweh; for I am in distress. My heart is troubled. My heart turns over within me, for I have grievously…
“Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held…
Remember my affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the bitterness.
“Remember, I beg you, the word that you commanded your servant Moses, saying, ‘If you trespass, I will scatter you…
Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.
Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?
Yahweh, you know. Remember me, visit me, and avenge me of my persecutors. You are patient, so don’t take me away. Know…
Yahweh, I have heard of your fame. I stand in awe of your deeds, Yahweh. Renew your work in the middle of the years. In…
He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”
All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, “Is this…
You have heard their reproach, Yahweh, and all their plans against me,
They said to me, “The remnant who are left of the captivity there in the province are in great affliction and reproach.…
“Hear, our God; for we are despised. Turn back their reproach on their own head. Give them up for a plunder in a land…
You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.
How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?
Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!
We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.
Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

translations.web: Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
translations.bsb: Remember, O LORD, what has happened to us. Look and see our disgrace!
translations.kjv: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
translations.asv: Remember, O Jehovah, what is come upon us: Behold, and see our reproach.
